headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high‑fliers and modest profit pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low single digits to over 50% YoY. Coforge led with 53.6% growth, while Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance to 1‑2%. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and TCS, but Wipro saw a 1.9% profit decline. AI contributions were highlighted across several firms but specific revenue figures were limited.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: Multiple companies cited AI‑led deals as a key driver of revenue acceleration.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance, reflecting a more cautious outlook.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but net profit fell 1.9% and headcount was reduced.
